HDB has not verified a project-wide key date, and tracker sources have disagreed on the month, so unit counts and any estimated month are left out of the facts below. This page sets out what is on file and how to plan your Farrer Park Arena renovation.

sections.heading: Planning your Farrer Park Arena interior
sections.text:
Farrer Park is a fine-grain, inner-city neighbourhood, and a new HDB home here usually has to work hard in a compact plan. The carpentry that typically does that job is a fitted kitchen, full-height wardrobes, an entry shoe cabinet, and a living-room storage wall, with a built-in desk if a common bedroom will be a study. Maison specifies built-in carpentry, photographed professionally, not IKEA-style furniture. We have no official floor plan on file and will not invent typologies or a typical Farrer Park Arena layout.

Farrer Park Fields is the other Farrer Park page in this batch and is also unconfirmed for keys; do not copy a date from one to the other. Verandah @ Kallang, Towner Residences and Kent Heights sit in the wider Kallang/Whampoa town, and Dorset Gardens is a nearby District 8 link. We will not invent walking times to Farrer Park MRT or to Little India. Check your block, facing and the HDB renovation rules before you plan blinds, a bench or any hacking, especially if the road is busy.

After keys, inspect defects, measure, and obtain the HDB renovation permit before fabrication. A moderate, non-structural carpentry scope is often planned at about six to ten weeks on site after access and approvals — an editorial allowance, not a guarantee. WhatsApp Maison with your plan and key letter if you have them. We are not affiliated with HDB.
